description: The file defines the MonkeyWaitEvent class, which represents a throttle/wait event in the Android Monkey testing framework. It is responsible for pausing execution for a specified duration during automated testing.

classes.name: MonkeyWaitEvent
classes.description: Represents a wait event that pauses execution for a specified amount of time during Monkey testing. It extends MonkeyEvent and overrides the injectEvent method to implement the sleep delay.

methods.name: MonkeyWaitEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a wait event with the specified wait time in milliseconds.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Performs the wait by sleeping for mWaitTime milliseconds and handles InterruptedException. Returns a success or failure code based on the execution.
